title: Query trace under relabeling leaves
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\Omega,\alpha,\beta$ be sets, and let $g:\alpha\to\beta$ be a map. For any finite decision tree over $\Omega$ with leaf labels in $\alpha$, replacing each leaf label $a$ by $g(a)$ leaves the query trace unchanged on every input $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a finite decision tree over $\Omega$ with leaf labels in $\alpha$ and some available coordinate set $A$
$x$ assigns a value in $\Omega$ to each coordinate
